Chapter 927: Chapter 23: Beyond The Nine Great Supreme (Subscribe Request)_2

Chapter 927: Chapter 23: Beyond the Nine Great Supreme (Subscribe Request)_2

Human civilization is one of the twelve peak powers of the Main Universe, occupying a territory approximately one-twentieth to one-thirtieth the size of the Main Universe.

In terms of area size, the territory of human civilization is three to four times that of the Immortal Realm.

However, human civilization has nine supreme evolutionary paths, while the Immortal Realm only has the Immortal Path cultivation system and the Martial Tao cultivation system, plus the evolutionary paths spread by Lin Yuan through his past ten interdimensional travels.

And among the humans in the Main Universe who cultivate the evolutionary path of Martial Tao.

The total number of cultivators in the nine great evolutionary paths of human civilization combined might actually be less than those on the Martial Tao evolutionary path.

After all, the Martial Tao evolutionary path is not limited to the Main Universe, but spans across endless dimensions and realms of all heavens.

Lin Yuan’s cultivation time is still short, and the number of travels he has experienced is also few, but as the worlds he travels to evolve, the spread of the Martial Tao evolutionary path will become even broader.

“I can feel that the more beings cultivate the Martial Tao evolutionary path, the lighter the suppression of the River of Time on me is…”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

This feeling was not apparent before his journey to the Immortal Realm, until the Martial Tao evolutionary path was thoroughly spread in the Immortal Realm.

Countless Martial Tao cultivators collectively uplifted Lin Yuan, an elevation not of divine faith, but under Lin Yuan’s control.

…

While Lin Yuan was inspecting himself.

A graceful lady, Jade Immortal, slowly walked into the palace.

This lady Jade Immortal was none other than the owner of Drunken Dream Tower. When Lin Yuan hurried to the Drunken Dream Tower, he casually revealed a trace of the aura from the Jade Immortal level, which led to the owner of the Drunken Dream Tower personally welcoming him.

Even for the Drunken Dream Tower, it was not every day that a Jade Immortal-level powerhouse visited; figures of the Jade Immortal level were revered guests no matter where they went.

“Immortal Monarch, this is our ‘Dream’ level Immortal Brew from the Drunken Dream Tower. Are you sure you want to drink this Immortal Brew?” The owner of the Drunken Dream Tower asked with a smile, her gaze gently resting on Lin Yuan.

The most famous Immortal Brew in the Drunken Dream Tower is also available at different levels. The Dream-level Immortal Brew is the ‘raw essence’ of the Immortal Brew. Even top Jade Immortals, if not careful, are unable to control plunging completely into a dream state.

This is a complete plunge, reducing perception of the outside world to the lowest level.

Therefore.

Even Jade Immortal-level existences who wish to taste the Immortal Brew would not opt for the Dream-level, as the risk is too great. Even though the Drunken Dream Tower has a good reputation, fully plunging into a dream can be quite embarrassing.

“No matter.”

Lin Yuan waved his hand.

The owner of the Drunken Dream Tower personally brought the Immortal Brew to Lin Yuan.

“Please drink, Immortal Monarch.” The owner of Drunken Dream Tower watched Lin Yuan with an expectant expression.

The formula for the Immortal Brew is adjusted periodically based on the responses of those immortals who drink it.

Other levels of Immortal Brew are okay, with many immortals consuming them, and the owner of the Drunken Dream Tower covertly observing and adjusting.

But the Dream-level Immortal Brew?

Even if a Jade Immortal wishes to try the taste of the Dream-level Immortal Brew, they usually buy it to drink in their own dwelling.

That way, even if they fall into a deep dream, they can ensure their own safety.

Those daring to order and directly drink the Dream-level Immortal Brew in the Drunken Dream Tower are truly very few.

The owner of the Drunken Dream Tower certainly did not want to miss this very rare observation opportunity.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Immortal Brew before him and directly picked it up to drink.

“The taste is quite decent.”

Lin Yuan savored it thoughtfully, and indeed, the Dream-level Immortal Brew could nourish the spirit and will.

However, Lin Yuan’s spiritual will was extremely strong, so the hallucinogenic effects of the brew almost had no effect on him.

Lin Yuan came to taste the Immortal Brew more as a trial, just to enjoy the gastronomic pleasure.

“Spiritual will strength increased a bit?”

Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow, unsure if it was due to the Immortal Brew, but at this moment, his spiritual will had slightly increased, imperceptibly.

After over a thousand years of cultivating at the core of the Origin of the Immortal Realm and understanding the rules of the Immortal Realm itself, Lin Yuan’s spiritual will strength had already increased to over 3,340,000 points.

…

“The taste… quite decent?”

The owner of the Drunken Dream Tower was slightly stunned, even doubting whether she served Lin Yuan the wrong brew—not the Dream-level but a regular Immortal Brew?

Otherwise, how could Lin Yuan still evaluate it so calmly now—

How’s the taste?

From the host of Drunken Dream Tower’s perspective, shouldn’t Lin Yuan’s normal reaction after drinking the dream-level Immortal Brew be to quickly fall into a dream, so she could thoroughly observe his reaction?

“This is Immortal Crystal.”

Lin Yuan left behind Immortal Crystals to pay for the dream-level Immortal Brew and vanished within the palace.

With Lin Yuan’s current power, being in the Origin of the Immortal Realm, he could condense as many Immortal Crystals as he desired if he wished.

….

“He really didn’t fall into a dream?”

The host of Drunken Dream Tower couldn’t believe it as she looked at the cup Lin Yuan had drunk from and subconsciously picked it up and gently licked it.

Suddenly.

A feeling of dizzying illusion surged to her heart.

Even just lightly tasting it, the host of Drunken Dream Tower began to uncontrollably fall into a dream.

“Drunken Dream Immortal Scripture, the unique true self.”

The host of Drunken Dream Tower immediately circulated her immortal power; as the creator of the Immortal Brew, she naturally had great resistance to any bewitching methods.

Even so, because the amount of Immortal Brew she tasted was just a trace, it took her several days to recover fully.

“It’s truly a dream-level Immortal Brew.”

The now sober host of Drunken Dream Tower didn’t feel the slightest joy, but instead fell into a sort of extraordinary shock.

Given her resistance to bewitching methods, even the top Jade Immortal would not match her. Despite this, just a tiny lick of the dream-level Immortal Brew nearly overwhelmed her, while Lin Yuan, who drank a whole cup, acted as if nothing had happened.

“To withstand the dream-level Immortal Brew… who is this person? Even a top-level Jade Immortal can’t do this…”

The host of Drunken Dream Tower felt unsettled for a long time, and faintly, she realized the young man who drank that cup of Immortal Brew probably had an extremely terrifying background.

…

In another Immortal City several Immortal Domains away from Qingyou Immortal City.

Lin Yuan leisurely walked along the open street.

“After over a thousand years, I still couldn’t grasp the Chaos Rule,” Lin Yuan thought as he walked, “I am very sure that I am incredibly close to it.”

A thousand years ago, the consciousness of the Immortal Realm compromised, allowing Lin Yuan to enter the core area and directly face many fundamental rules.

Since then, Lin Yuan had made unprecedented rapid progress in rule comprehension, gaining new pillar-level fusion rules at every moment.

This rapid progress lasted for a thousand years.

From a thousand years ago to now, the pillar-level fusion rules that Lin Yuan newly comprehended had reached over three million types, raising all of them to the Seventh Realm.

The Seventh Realm of pillar-level fusion rules, under normal circumstances, is only accessible by those at the twelfth tier ultimate level.

Lin Yuan not only stepped into it, but he did so with over three million types at once.

In terms of the accumulation of foundational knowledge in rule comprehension, even excluding understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, Lin Yuan believed that even a large part of the twelfth tier ultimate level couldn’t match him.

Even so.

Lin Yuan still hadn’t completely understood the Chaos Rule.

“It seems I’ve been very fortunate.”

“If I hadn’t arrived in the Immortal Realm, never entered the core of the Primordial Lands, reaching this step would probably need tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of years.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts retracted as he secretly thought to himself.

The core of the Origin of the Immortal Realm was indeed of great help to him.

Of course, this was also because Lin Yuan’s comprehension was extraordinary, unlike others, even the Ancestor of the Immortal Path couldn’t fathom three million types of pillar-level fusion rules at the core, raising them all to the Seventh Realm, even after a thousand years.

Let alone a thousand years, even a hundred billion or a trillion years would not be achievable.

Fathoming so many pillar-level fusion rules wasn’t just about having time; there were countless bottlenecks and constraints, the slightest stagnation could mean billions of years passing.

“The internal world…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted slightly, descending into his internal world.

Though it was just an incarnation, it shared the same consciousness, and the understanding of rules was synchronized.

Hence, the internal world was also filled with endless rule fluctuations.

All rule fluctuations appeared substantial, converging into a huge, towering ‘egg’, spanning under the sky.
